facts.fact: ONECI's CityWeb web application, which records birth, marriage and death acts, is deployed in several regions and town halls, with 5,453 acts at Abobo in September 2026 and up to 62.5% of centres inactive in Moronou.
CityWeb lets registrars create, process and follow birth, marriage and death acts, according to the ONECI account reported by Digital Mag.
